textbookBox.concept: In football, we kick the ball to teammates and receive it with our feet. Kicking directs the ball to a target; receiving controls it so we do not lose it.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 physical-education · Kicking and Receiving · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: To kick: stand about 5 metres behind the ball and keep your eyes on it. Run towards it.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: To kick: stand about 5 metres behind the ball and keep your eyes on it. Run towards it.
beats.speakEn: To kick: stand about 5 metres behind the ball and keep your eyes on it. Run towards it.

beats.en: Keep the non-kicking foot beside the ball. Kick with the inner part or top of the kicking foot.
beats.speakEn: Keep the non-kicking foot beside the ball. Kick with the inner part or top of the kicking foot.

type: Key Concept: To kick: stand about 5 metres behind the ball and keep your eyes on it. Run towards it.
Rule: Keep the non-kicking foot beside the ball. Kick with the inner part or top of the kicking foot.

textbookBox.concept: Swing the arms sideways and follow through in the direction of the kick, smoothly and without a jerk.

beats.en: To receive: anticipate the direction and speed of the ball and take your position, raising the leg you want to receive with.
